latest_release.body:
Think of CleanYourTV as the Linux of smart TVs: an open base that anyone can start from. In four days, people built on it again: **five new themes**, from photos taken on the space station to a snowy night with Santa's sleigh, two new add-ons, and **212 projects in the showcase**, made by people who took the launcher and made it theirs. The launcher itself gets fixes for clocks that stopped, Mi TV picture settings and remote buttons that opened the wrong app.

Since v3.3.0: **442 TV models** (from 407), **117 brands** (from 106), **21 themes** (from 16), **33 add-ons** (from 31), **212 projects in the showcase** (from 177), **247 pull requests from 143 people** in four days. No binaries, as always: build the launcher with `launcher/build-and-install.sh`.

## Highlights
- **Security improvements** in the tools and in the way contributions are tested
- **Five new themes** (21 now): **aerial**, **christmas**, **stockholm**, **dock-glass** and **weeb**
- **212 projects in the showcase**, among them four Continue watching shelves, a split-flap Departures board and the Nothing OS look
- **35 more TVs from 11 new brands**: AiPro4K, HAAM, Jio, KUNFT, Kodak, Philco, Smarttech, SunWind, Tesla, VISIO and X.Vision
- **Clocks that keep moving** on TCL Android 9 TVs that stop the minute tick after standby (#3044)
- **Picture settings on Mi TVs**: Quick Settings opens Xiaomi's own picture page instead of an empty one (#3260)
- **Two new add-ons**: **Tatami**, a screensaver of small rooms that rearrange themselves (#3181), and **Lịch Vạn Niên**, an offline Vietnamese lunar almanac (#3136)
- **The README in Brazilian Portuguese** (#3111), and the Italian docs grow by four pages (#3152, #3153)

## Themes
- **aerial**: NASA photos from the International Space Station, in the spirit of Apple TV's Aerials, each with its caption (#3126)
- **christmas**: a snowy night with Santa's sleigh, drawn in code and CC0, until 6 January 2027 (#2802)
- **stockholm**: Riddarfjärden in eight lights through the day, drawn in code and CC0 (#3125)
- **dock-glass**: one glass dock over the wallpaper, nothing else (#3107)
- **weeb**: original neon-outline anime characters on black (#2924)

Twenty-one themes now, the built-in `default/` included. Apply one with `tools/theme.sh`, no rebuild; browse them at **[cleanyour.tv/addons](https://cleanyour.tv/addons)**.

## Launcher 3.4
Nothing changes unless your TV needed the fix or a theme turns a switch on.
- **Clocks keep moving** where the firmware stops sending the minute tick after a power-button standby, as a TCL UnionTV on Android 9 does: Home's clock and the clock screensaver redraw each minute and when the screen comes back (#3044)
- **Picture settings on Mi TVs**: on Xiaomi sets, Android's display settings is an empty page, so Quick Settings now opens Xiaomi's own picture settings where they're installed (#3260)
- **A remote button mapped to an input** (`app_keys` with `input:`) opens through the Live TV app first, as the Inputs menu already does. On a TCL G03 the TV button opened an "Open with" box instead of the tuner (#3173)
- **`inputs_cec_state_only`**: for TVs that report HDMI connections on the wrong port, only devices that speak HDMI-CEC show a connection state in the Inputs list. Off by default (#2998)
- **Hebrew**: Right from Settings reaches Wi-Fi again in the mirrored top bar (#3151)

**Fixes**
- Add to dock works when the app already sits in the free place (#2923)
- `show_stats` shows the memory figure on older kernels without MemAvailable, like a Philips on Android TV 8 (#2994)
- Simplified Chinese: "Remove from Home" reads more naturally (#3034)

## Add-ons (two new, in `addons/`)
- **Tatami**: a screensaver of small rooms that rearrange themselves (#3181)
- **Lịch Vạn Niên**: an offline Vietnamese lunar almanac card (#3136)

Your own lists can live outside the repository: list paths are relative to the directory you run from, and absolute paths work too.
Windows (PowerShell) Every script has a PowerShell twin next to it. Install Python 3 and a JDK from 17 through 22, and in the SDK Manager add platform 34 and build-tools 34 (34.0.0 or any newer 34.x). The script uses `JAVA_HOME` when it points at a JDK in that range, and otherwise Android Studio's bundled JDK when that JDK is in the same range: ```powershell python -m venv tools\venv; tools\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r tools\requirements.txt powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File launcher\build-and-install.ps1 -TvHost 192.168.1.50 powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\disable.ps1 -TvHost 192.168.1.50 examples\xiaomi-mi-tv-4a\debloat.txt powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\restore.ps1 -TvHost 192.168.1.50 examples\xiaomi-mi-tv-4a\debloat.txt powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\theme.ps1 -TvHost 192.168.1.50 themes\aurora ``` The last two are the undo and a theme push, the `tools/restore.sh` and `tools/theme.sh` lines the sections above give in bash. On Google TV the undo takes the stock launcher as well: `-Stock com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx`.
How the scripts protect Home The install scripts ask the TV which launcher owns Home and only disable one they recognise, the four in `KNOWN_STOCK_LAUNCHERS`: `com.google.android.tvlauncher`, `com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx`, `com.google.android.leanbacklauncher` and Xiaomi's `com.mitv.tvhome` (PatchWall). Pass `STOCK_LAUNCHER=` (`-StockLauncher`) to override, or `none` to leave it alone. `tools/disable.sh` (`disable.ps1`) applies the same rule before it disables anything: - If the list contains the app that owns Home and no other app on the TV answers HOME, it skips that entry, says why, and disables the rest of the list. So a list applied before the launcher handover cannot leave the TV with nothing to start. - The setup wizard, the settings apps, a vendor `FallbackHome` and factory-test apps (Xiaomi's `com.duokan.factorytest`) answer HOME too and don't count. - On Google TV it also keeps the owner while setupwraith answers HOME and stays enabled (not listed, or kept for the Wi-Fi network): setupwraith answers ahead of an installed launcher that is not Home yet, so it would take Home. Run the same list again once `launcher/build-and-install.sh` has made the new launcher Home and the entry is applied; `FORCE_HOME=1` (`$env:FORCE_HOME`) disables it anyway.
## The microphone, and what can be said about it "Which of these packages is listening?" has no honest one-line answer: a permission scan shows fifty system packages with `RECORD_AUDIO` that record nothing, and ACR clients see the screen with no audio permission at all. [`tools/privacy.py`](tools/privacy.py) reports what the TV actually says, with the evidence for each voice, ACR and telemetry candidate: `TV_HOST=192.168.1.50 tools/venv/bin/python -I tools/privacy.py`, and `--write` turns them into a normal debloat list. What the audit cannot do is prove intent: [docs/privacy.md](docs/privacy.md) explains why. ## The launcher A small native home screen for Android TV: **about 572 KB**, plain Java, built for TVs with 1 GB of RAM. No blur, no video, no network permission, no background services. The **TV** needs Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer, the `minSdk` in [`launcher/app/build.gradle`](launcher/app/build.gradle); what is left on an older set is in [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md). | What | How it works | |---|---| | **Configure** | Dock order, hidden apps, Live TV app, 4 to 7 tiles per row, reduced motion. All in [`config.xml`](launcher/app/src/main/res/values/config.xml) | | **Settings on the TV** | Hold OK on Settings for launcher settings. Optional `launcher_settings_button` makes a normal click open them directly; TV settings remain on the settings page and their app tile. | | **Themes** | Background, wallpaper and layout from a `config.json` pushed over Wi-Fi, no rebuild. Twenty-eight ship in [`themes/`](themes/), the built-in `default/` included | | **31 languages** | Follows the TV's language, with a fully mirrored right-to-left layout for Hebrew | | **App library** | Optional: browse every installed app and add or remove Home shortcuts. See [the app library guide](docs/app-library.md) | | **Tile menu** | On by default (`tile_menu`): hold OK on a tile for Move and App info, plus Remove from Home when the app library is on. Off, holding OK opens App info | | **Module cards** | Any TV app can offer its own tile; you approve each one once. See [`docs/modules.md`](docs/modules.md) | | **Add-ons** | Optional apps that plug in as module cards, kept in [`addons/`](addons/) and never built into the launcher | | **Clock screensaver** | A drifting clock over the glow, so nothing burns in | | **Remote keys** | Keeps the Input, YouTube and gear buttons working after the stock launcher is gone | Themes, switches and add-ons together, with screenshots: [cleanyour.tv/addons](https://cleanyour.tv/addons). **More:** [docs/launcher.md](docs/launcher.md) has the launcher settings page row by row, changing the default home, the languages, remote keys, the Clock screensaver, navigation and building it yourself.
Your own photos as the background A theme can rotate a folder of pictures behind Home, with no rebuild. No pictures ship with the repo: you bring your own, and you decide you have the right to show them. 1. **Start a theme folder.** Copy a theme you like from the [themes folder](themes/), for example `themes/aurora`, into a new folder such as `mytheme/`, or start with an empty `config.json`. 2. **Prepare the photos.** A bright 12 MP photo is heavy for a 1 to 2 GB TV and drowns the clock and tiles. `tools/wallpaper_prep.py` centre-crops to 16:9, saves 1280×720 JPEGs under 300 KB, and darkens the picture itself, so `wallpaper_dim` can stay at 0. HEIC phone photos work. Your originals are never touched. ```bash python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements-photos.txt python3 tools/wallpaper_prep.py ~/Pictures/trip mytheme/wallpapers ``` Options: `--brightness 0.25` (0.1 to 1.0), `--gradient 0.6` (extra black toward the dock), `--size 1280x720`, `--max-kb 300`. 3. **Set the rotation** in `mytheme/config.json`: ```json { "wallpaper": true, "wallpaper_rotation_minutes": 1, "wallpaper_order": "shuffle", "wallpaper_dim": 0 } ``` | Key | Notes | |---|---| | `wallpaper_rotation_minutes` | Whole minutes, 0 to 1440. **1 is the fastest.** `0` means no rotation, and a fraction such as `0.25` is read as `0`, which stops it. | | `wallpaper_order` | `shuffle` never shows the same picture twice in a row; `sequential` follows the file names. | | `wallpaper_dim` | Black overlay in percent. Leave at 0 when the pictures are already darkened. | | `dock_glass`, `dock_opacity` | A frosted-glass dock band (30 to 100%) so the picture shows behind the tiles. | | `greeting_name` | A name after the greeting: "Good evening, Sam". | | `show_stats`, `app_library`, `reduced_motion` | A stats line under the clock, an App library pill, calmer motion for weak GPUs. | 4. **Push it to the TV** (this restarts Home once, and keeps the Home-key helper working): ```bash tools/theme.sh mytheme # Windows: tools\theme.ps1 -TvHost 192.168.1.50 mytheme ``` On the TV, **Launcher settings → Wallpaper** holds one picture, **None**, or **Theme default**, which rotates again. 5. **Take it off** with `tools/theme.sh --reset`. What it cannot do: there is no crossfade (the picture changes with a cut), no rotation faster than a minute, and the Clock screensaver shows time and date only, never photos. Without a `wallpapers/` folder the theme still works and Home keeps its plain colour. A picture is decoded into memory while Home shows it: about 4 MB at 1080p in the default 16-bit colour, 8 MB with `wallpaper_true_color` (see [themes/README.md](themes/README.md)), so keep the pictures small on a 1 GB TV.
## Restoring your TV Keep the list you applied. One line puts the TV back the way it was: ```bash TV_HOST=192.168.1.50 tools/restore.sh examples//debloat.txt # Android TV TV_HOST=192.168.1.50 tools/restore.sh examples//debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx # Google TV ``` | What | How | |---|---| | **A record comes first** | Before `tools/disable.sh` changes anything it writes down what the TV looked like, in `~/.cleanyourtv/`. | | **Restore replays it** | A package you had disabled yourself stays disabled, and Home goes back to the component that owned it. | | **The launcher stays installed** | Remove it from the TV's Settings → Apps if you want it gone. | | **No computer?** | If the TV is unreachable, its own Settings → Apps page can re-enable packages too. | **More:** [docs/restore.md](docs/restore.md) has what the record holds, when the stock launcher argument counts, and what happens without a record. ## After a firmware update An update installs over the cleaned-up system: the listed packages come back, Home goes to the stock launcher, and new preloads appear that no list mentions. Open ADB again as in [Quick start](#quick-start) step 1, then compare the TV with the list you applied; `--fix` puts it back: ```bash TV_HOST=192.168.1.50 tools/venv/bin/python -I tools/check.py examples//debloat.txt ``` **More:** [docs/firmware-updates.md](docs/firmware-updates.md) has the exit codes, a weekly check, what `--fix` changes, TVs that keep the stock launcher as Home, and lists that disable the updater. ## When something goes wrong The full list of things that bit us is in [docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md). The three that matter most: - 🍎 **macOS reports "No route to host" although the port is open**: Local Network privacy keeps the terminal app off the local subnet, and the permission belongs to that app rather than to the client, so the stock `adb` and `tools/tv.py` fail the same way (seen on macOS 26). Allow Terminal, iTerm2 or VS Code under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network, then quit and reopen it ([Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#connecting)). - ⚠️ **Disable the stock launcher only after the new one is installed and running**, or Home lands on a factory test app. The install script orders this for you. - 🔁 **On Google TV the setup wizard** (`com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith`) can take Home and crash-loop the system after the stock launcher is disabled. Disable it too, and list it in your `debloat.txt` so restore brings it back. - But check `dumpsys wifi | grep -o 'cname=[^ ]*'` first: if the Wi-Fi network was saved during setup it belongs to setupwraith, and disabling it deletes the network (re-join it in Settings first; `tools/disable.sh` skips setupwraith until you do). - On Google's own Chromecast and on the Google TV Streamer it also costs phone casting, see [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md). - Stuck already? `tools/tv.py 'pm enable --user 0 com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx'`. On some sets (seen on a TCL Smart TV Pro, Android 14) this is one-way: getting back to this launcher then needs ADB, or keep launcherx and use `stock_home_redirect`, see [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md#working-on-the-tv). ## Questions people ask
I don't code and don't have a laptop. Can I still do this? Yes. Independent developers have built free, open-source apps on CleanYourTV's TV lists that do the cleanup over Wi-Fi, with no coding agent. Each shows a plan first, only switches apps off, and can put everything back: | App | For | By | |---|---|---| | [Clean Your TV app](https://github.com/udhaykumarbala/cleanyourtv-app) | Android phone | [@udhaykumarbala](https://github.com/udhaykumarbala) | | [Tellyscope](https://github.com/man15h/tellyscope) | Android phone | [@man15h](https://github.com/man15h) | | [TidyTV](https://github.com/jolan94/tidytv) | Android phone, Google Play | [@jolan94](https://github.com/jolan94) | | [CleanMyTV](https://github.com/wingedpanther/cleanmytv) | Mac and Windows | [@wingedpanther](https://github.com/wingedpanther) | These apps are independent projects, not affiliated with or endorsed by CleanYourTV or its maintainer, and each is provided as is under its own license. Report app problems in that app's repo. More at [cleanyour.tv/app](https://cleanyour.tv/app).
Is this safe? Can it brick the TV? Nothing is flashed, rooted or deleted; packages are disabled in the user profile. The risk is disabling something the TV leans on, which is why lists are applied in small batches with a restore script ready. The TV's own Settings → Apps page can re-enable packages even without the tools. If the TV no longer starts far enough for that, a factory reset from its recovery menu is usually the way back. More: [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md#is-this-safe-can-it-brick-the-tv)
What about firmware updates? The updater is left on in most lists, so firmware updates arrive as usual. Some lists disable the TV's own updater, and on those a firmware update arrives only when you re-enable it. When one does land it installs over the cleaned-up system, so a package comes back and you re-run the script: see [After a firmware update](#after-a-firmware-update).
Won't the apps break? Streaming apps still update through the Play Store, which is left alone. The launcher just lists what is installed and launches it with intents that have been stable for a decade.
How do I rearrange my apps? Hold OK on **Settings** (top right) and choose **Reorder apps**. OK picks an app up, the arrows move it, Back places it, and Back again finishes. Holding OK on a tile also offers **Move** (`tile_menu`, on by default), which picks that app up straight away. More: [docs/launcher.md](docs/launcher.md#launcher-settings-and-the-default-home)
Can I do this for someone in another home? Yes, over a private [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) link instead of the same Wi-Fi: either Tailscale on their TV, shared with you, or a computer or Apple TV at their home routing to it. Never by opening the ADB port on their router. Step by step in [docs/REMOTE.md](docs/REMOTE.md).
Isn't ADB access a security hole? It is one explicit "allow this computer" tap on the TV, the same as developing an Android app. Network ADB is plaintext on port 5555, and on some firmware any device on the LAN gets a shell, so close it when you are done: 1. On the TV: Developer options → turn **USB debugging**, **Network/ADB debugging** and **Wireless debugging** off, whichever the TV has, and revoke the USB debugging authorisations. 2. Reboot the TV, then confirm the port is gone from your computer: `python3 tools/adb-closed.py ` must say the port is closed. The launcher keeps working without debugging. More, including checking Wireless debugging's own port: [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md#isnt-adb-access-a-security-hole)
Can it block ads inside apps too? Partly, with Android's Private DNS (Android 9 and newer). Point it at an ad-blocking resolver such as [AdGuard DNS](https://adguard-dns.io) and every app's ad and tracker domains stop resolving, system-wide, surviving reboots. The trade-off: that resolver then sees every DNS query the TV makes, and it does not remove YouTube ads. More, with the two commands and how to switch back: [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md#can-it-block-ads-inside-apps-too)
Are there switches in the TV's own Settings worth flipping too? A few, and they need no ADB: the advertising ID, Location, Usage & diagnostics and Scanning always available, plus Apps only mode where the stock launcher stays. Flip Usage & diagnostics before the debloat; on some TVs its page goes with it. More, with the paths for Google TV, Android TV and Fire OS: [docs/faq.md](docs/faq.md#are-there-switches-in-the-tvs-own-settings-worth-flipping-too)
AirPlay? Not from this repo. Chromecast built-in stays for Android phones. For iPhones, [jqssun/android-airplay-server](https://github.com/jqssun/android-airplay-server) works; an install script for it is in [PR #84](https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv/pull/84).
Can I just download the APK? Build it with the one-line script in [Doing it by hand](#doing-it-by-hand); it takes a minute and you control what goes on your TV. That needs the JDK and Android SDK named there. No prebuilt binaries.
## The story On 17 October 2026 I posted [a before and after](https://x.com/gathint/status/2111379569030939102) of my parents' TV, cleaned up by Claude Code over Wi-Fi. It reached 8.6M views, people started doing the same to their own TVs, and their replies turned into the lists here: 170+ TV models from 200+ contributors in the first four days. The repo was called tv-vibehack until the 19th; old links work. Two weeks on, it was the #1 trending repository on GitHub for the week of 19–25 October, with over 46K stars and 5.7K forks, and 1.4M views and 260K clones in 14 days. The lists now cover 463 TV models from 124 brands. The coverage: 412 articles from 54 countries and 229 videos on YouTube and Bilibili, all in [docs/PRESS.md](docs/PRESS.md) (numbers as of 31 October 2026). ## Contributing The most useful contribution is your TV's debloat list, so the next person with that model does not have to rediscover it. [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) has the format and the testing we ask for. Contributing through a coding agent? [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) gives it the same rules. | How to help | What it means | |---|---| | **Your TV's debloat list** | The most useful one: the next person with that model skips the discovery. | | **Launcher and prompt** | Launcher improvements and sharper prompt wording are welcome too. | | **Built something on top?** | A launcher, a port, a theme: add it to [SHOWCASE.md](SHOWCASE.md), where two hundred and thirty projects already live, sorted into home screens, forks, add-ons, tools and other platforms, with an index by TV brand. | The people whose work is in this repo:

# CleanYourTV 中文使用指南 通过局域网连接 Android TV 或 Google TV，停用不需要的预装应用、广告和遥测服务，并在兼容设备上安装简洁的原生桌面。无需 root、刷机或 USB 数据线；清理工具采用停用方式，不卸载系统应用，并提供恢复脚本。 本文介绍通用功能和使用方法。不同机型、地区和固件的应用包及限制可能不同，请先核对自己的设备。功能变化以[英文 README](README.md)为准，具体机型记录见[机型清单](examples/README.md)。 **Samsung、LG、Roku 或其他非 Android 电视？** CleanYourTV 无法在这些电视上运行，但你仍可以用遥控器一步步关闭跟踪功能：[cleanyour.tv/not-android](https://cleanyour.tv/not-android) ![原生 Google TV 桌面与 CleanYourTV 桌面对比](docs/stock-vs-new-side.jpg) ## 工作原理 电视开启开发者选项中的 USB 调试，建立并授权网络 ADB 连接后，就可以完成以下步骤： 1. **备份**已安装应用列表及相关设置。使用[操作提示词](PROMPT.md)时，先让助手保存完整快照；手动使用 `tools/disable.sh` 时，工具仅保存恢复该停用列表所需的状态。 2. **按需停用**厂商遥测、广告服务、推荐内容和不需要的预装应用，使用的是 `pm disable-user`。 3. **安装简洁桌面**，并将其设为默认 HOME。 各品牌需要保留的系统组件不同。[操作提示词](PROMPT.md)会引导编程助手先检查实际设备，再确认你使用哪些应用和功能。 ## 快速开始 准备一台与电视连接同一局域网的电脑，以及可以运行终端命令的编程助手，例如 [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code)、[Codex](https://github.com/openai/codex) 或 [Gemini CLI](https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli)。 | 步骤 | 操作 | |---|---| | 1. 电视端 | 打开「设置 → 设备偏好设置 → 关于」，在「版本号 / Build」上连续按七次确定，返回后进入开发者选项，开启 USB 调试。如果另有网络调试或 ADB 调试开关，也需要开启。菜单名称因机型而异。 | | 2. 电脑端 | 先克隆仓库并在助手中打开该文件夹（`git clone https://github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv`），再将 [`PROMPT.md`](PROMPT.md) 的内容交给助手，填写电视型号。 | | 3. 确认需求 | 在电视上接受调试授权，告诉助手常用应用、底部快捷栏中的应用，以及是否保留语音助手、Chromecast 和系统更新。 | | 4. 检查结果 | 按提示完成备份、清理和安装，检查应用启动、遥控器操作、输入源和恢复路径。 | 先克隆仓库的意义在于：助手会直接使用本仓库的 `tools/disable.sh` 和 `launcher/build-and-install.sh`，不会另写一套；备份、默认桌面保护和恢复记录都在其中。 ## 桌面功能 - **简洁首页**：深色背景，默认四个常用应用组成底部快捷栏。 - **应用聚焦展示**：显示当前应用名称；环境色优先从应用横幅提取，没有横幅时才从图标提取。 - **应用网格**：按向下键进入更多应用，支持每行 4、5、6 或 7 个。 - **遥控器排序**：从设置按钮的长按菜单进入排序模式，调整应用位置。 - **可选应用库**：浏览已安装且可启动的应用，用遥控器添加或移除首页快捷方式。 - **动效控制**：可开关动态效果，也可单独启用高级动态效果。 - **常用入口**：Wi-Fi / 以太网和系统设置；设备有可识别的 HDMI、AV、直播电视或已配置来源面板时，还会显示输入源入口。HDMI 名称沿用电视系统中的命名。 - **时钟与屏保**：问候语、时间、日期，以及配套的时钟屏保。 - **主题**：通过配置文件调整颜色、壁纸、快捷栏和列数，无需重新编译。 - **模块卡片**：其他应用可以提供桌面卡片，需用户同意才会显示。 ![应用聚焦效果](docs/focus-2-up-netflix.png) ### 在电视上调整设置 默认短按「设置」打开电视系统设置，长按后可进入「简洁桌面设置」。在配置或主题中启用 `launcher_settings_button` 后，顶部改为独立的「简洁桌面设置」按钮，短按即可进入；长按仍可打开模块卡片和应用排序工具，电视系统设置也可从设置页面或下方应用图标进入。 启用独立按钮后，页面还提供「调整应用顺序」，点击即可返回桌面进入移动模式。 可调整： | 选项 | 作用 | |---|---| | 每行应用数量 | 选择 4、5、6 或 7 个，列数增加时卡片相应缩小。 | | 动态效果 | 开启或关闭桌面动画。 | | 高级动态效果 | 增加卡片上浮、图标缩放和背景颜色平滑过渡。可能增加内存占用，实际影响取决于电视。 | | 跟随主题（重置电视端设置） | 清除电视端的布局与动效选择，恢复当前主题或内置配置。推送或重置主题也会清除这些选择。 | | 默认桌面入口 | 打开 Android 的默认桌面选择页，切换到原始桌面或 CleanYourTV。 | 默认桌面入口不负责重新启用已停用的原始桌面。如果原始桌面已被安装脚本停用，需要先按下文恢复。部分电视不提供系统桌面选择页。还可以通过 `show_home_settings_shortcut` 配置单独显示该入口。 ### 排序与应用库 在桌面「设置」按钮上长按确定，通过菜单进入排序模式。按确定选中要移动的应用，用方向键调整位置，再按确定或返回放下；没有拿起应用时，按返回退出排序并保存。顶部独立排序按钮默认隐藏，可通过配置或主题的 `reorder_button` 开启。 应用库默认关闭，在配置或主题中启用 `app_library` 后，入口显示在首页应用的最后一行之后。它可以列出具有电视或普通 Android 启动入口的应用；普通 Android 应用可能仍需触摸或鼠标操作。 另可启用默认关闭的 `app_library_selection`：按确定直接切换右上角勾选，选择是否在首页显示。已勾选和未勾选分别按显示名称排序，勾选组排在前面；取消后焦点选相邻的下一个，末尾则选前一个，不跟随隐藏的应用移到后组。 - 对尚未添加到首页的应用按确定，可添加快捷方式。 - 对已经在首页的应用按确定，可打开应用；长按可打开操作菜单，添加或移除首页快捷方式，也可查看应用信息。 - 从首页移除不会卸载应用。相关选择在重启、应用更新及推送或重置主题后保留。 详见[应用库说明](docs/app-library.md)。 ## 支持哪些设备 清理清单面向 **Android TV / Google TV**；当前桌面 APK 要求 **Android 8.0（API 26）或更高版本**。社区提供了多种电视与电视盒子的配置；其中一些设备运行的 Android 版本低于桌面的最低要求，清理清单不代表桌面可安装。请在[机型清单](examples/README.md)中核对型号、地区和固件，阅读对应目录的说明，再使用停用列表。 - Samsung Tizen 和 LG webOS 不能直接运行本项目的 Android 桌面；[docs/devices/samsung-tizen.md](docs/devices/samsung-tizen.md) 记录了一台 2021 年 Tizen 机型在局域网里暴露的接口（没有 ADB，因而无法停用应用），社区移植项目可参考[社区作品](SHOWCASE.md)。如需在 Samsung、LG、Roku 等非 Android 电视上关闭跟踪功能，请看 [cleanyour.tv/not-android](https://cleanyour.tv/not-android)。 - Fire TV 的清理记录可供手动适配；[操作提示词](PROMPT.md)不适用于 Fire TV，Fire OS 也限制替换默认桌面。 - 部分中国大陆版电视会拒绝侧载 APK 或安装第三方 HOME 桌面，已记录的 TCL 机型只是其中的例子。不能仅凭品牌判断兼容性。 - 没有现成清单时，可以让助手检查实际设备，并按[贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)提交经过验证的机型记录。 ## 手动操作 以下命令从仓库根目录运行。`192.168.1.50` 是示例地址，请替换为电视的局域网地址。`tools/tv.py` 默认连接传统 TCP ADB 的 5555 端口；如果电视只提供需要配对的「无线调试」，须先按[操作提示词中的连接步骤](PROMPT.md)配对并开启 5555 端口，才能使用下列命令。 ### 1. 准备连接工具 连接工具需要 Python 3： ```bash python3 -m venv tools/venv tools/venv/bin/pip install -r tools/requirements.txt export TV_HOST=192.168.1.50 # 读取型号、Android 版本和固件 tools/venv/bin/python -I tools/tv.py --probe # 查看已安装的应用包 tools/venv/bin/python -I tools/tv.py 'pm list packages' ``` ### 2. 按需应用停用列表 **下面的小米路径仅为示例，请替换为与你的电视匹配且已核对的列表。** 不要将其他机型的列表直接用于自己的电视。 ```bash tools/disable.sh examples/xiaomi-mi-tv-4a/debloat.txt ``` 列表路径相对于运行命令时所在的目录，也可以使用绝对路径。保留原列表及工具生成的恢复记录，方便撤销。手动流程若还需要完整的应用和设置快照，应在停用前另行保存；`tools/disable.sh` 不会生成该快照。 ### 3. 编译和安装桌面 桌面使用 Java 和 AndroidX RecyclerView，应用包名为 `com.gathin.tvhome`。编译需要 JDK 17、Android SDK Platform 34 和 Build Tools 34.0.0。macOS 可安装： ```bash brew install openjdk@17 android-commandlinetools sdkmanager "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0" ``` Linux 安装脚本可查找 `~/Android/Sdk` 和 `PATH` 中的 Java。准备好环境后运行： ```bash TV_HOST=192.168.1.50 launcher/build-and-install.sh ``` **此 Shell 脚本不仅安装 APK，还会切换默认 HOME，并按检测结果停用原始桌面。** 它先确认新桌面能够启动，再完成切换；切换失败时尝试回退。自动识别仅支持 `com.google.android.tvlauncher`、`com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx`、`com.google.android.leanbacklauncher` 和 `com.mitv.tvhome`；若识别失败，需核对设备后指定 `STOCK_LAUNCHER=<包名>`，或使用 `none`。 可使用 `STOCK_LAUNCHER=<包名>` 指定原始桌面；如果希望保留原始桌面的启用状态，使用： ```bash TV_HOST=192.168.1.50 STOCK_LAUNCHER=none launcher/build-and-install.sh ``` `none` 只表示不停用原始桌面，**仍会将 CleanYourTV 设为默认 HOME**。 ### Windows 仓库提供对应的 PowerShell 脚本。安装 Python 和 Android Studio，并确认上述 JDK、SDK 组件可用后： ```powershell python -m venv tools\venv tools\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r tools\requirements.txt powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File launcher\build-and-install.ps1 -TvHost 192.168.1.50 ``` PowerShell 安装脚本使用 `-StockLauncher <包名>` 指定原始桌面，或使用 `-StockLauncher none` 保留其启用状态。当前 PowerShell 脚本会先请求设置新 HOME，再检查新桌面是否启动，与上述 Shell 脚本的顺序不同；操作前请确认 ADB 恢复路径可用。清理与恢复分别使用 [`tools/disable.ps1`](tools/disable.ps1) 和 [`tools/restore.ps1`](tools/restore.ps1)。 ### 工具索引 | 工具 | 用途 | |---|---| | [`tools/tv.py`](tools/tv.py) | Python ADB HOME。 | ## 更多配置 ### 布局与主题 内置配置位于 [`config.xml`](launcher/app/src/main/res/values/config.xml)，可设置快捷栏顺序、隐藏应用、直播电视包名、列数、快捷栏下方的行数、网络按钮关联的 VPN 应用，以及 `reduced_motion` 等选项。 还可通过 `show_stats` 尝试显示 CPU、可用内存和可用存储空间，默认关闭，开启后仅在首页显示期间刷新。设备禁止读取 CPU 数据时会省略 CPU 一项。`greeting_name` 可设置问候语中的名字。 主题通过 `config.json` 覆盖内置配置，还可提供背景色和壁纸。使用示例： ```bash TV_HOST=192.168.1.50 tools/theme.sh themes/aurora ``` 恢复内置主题： ```bash TV_HOST=192.168.1.50 tools/theme.sh --reset ``` 主题格式和可用配置见 [`themes/README.md`](themes/README.md)。 ### 语言、屏保与遥控器 以下 ADB 命令使用 macOS/Linux 的虚拟环境路径；Windows 将前缀 `tools/venv/bin/python -I tools/tv.py` 换为 `tools\venv\Scripts\python.exe -I tools\tv.py`。 - **语言**：桌面**没有应用内语言开关**，语言由系统决定，简体中文和繁体中文都已包含。 - **Android 13 及以上**可以只给桌面单独设语言：`tools/venv/bin/python -I tools/tv.py 'cmd locale set-app-locales com.gathin.tvhome --locales zh-CN'`（切英文把 `zh-CN` 换成 `en`）。查当前值用 `cmd locale get-app-locales com.gathin.tvhome`。 - **Android 12 及以下**只能改电视的系统语言，桌面跟着走。国内电视出厂通常已是简体中文，一般不用动。 - **时钟屏保**可在电视的屏保设置中选择 Clock；也可执行：`tools/venv/bin/python -I tools/tv.py 'settings put secure screensaver_components com.gathin.tvhome/.ClockDream; settings put secure screensaver_enabled 1'`。 - **输入源键**可在 macOS/Linux 安装时使用 `INPUT_KEY_SERVICE=1` 启用辅助功能服务，以适配 Google TV 的遥控器输入源按钮；Windows 使用 `-InputKeyService`。 - **HOME / 设置键**可在 macOS/Linux 安装时使用 `HOME_KEY_SERVICE=1`，并通过 `config.xml` 中的按键配置适配部分设备；Windows 使用 `-HomeKeyService`。`settings_key_panel` 可启用快捷设置面板，提供电视设置、显示、网络、应用和桌面设置入口。重装时需重新传入所需的服务选项。 ### 模块卡片 应用可声明自己的卡片名称、说明和环境色。桌面会询问是否显示，默认保持隐藏，并按应用签名及卡片名称保存选择。在桌面「设置」按钮上长按确定，选择模块卡片菜单即可管理。 开发说明见 [`docs/modules.md`](docs/modules.md)，接口约定见 [`docs/specs/card.md`](docs/specs/card.md)。 ## 恢复原始桌面和应用 `tools/disable.sh` 在停用前记录列表内各应用的状态（启用、已停用或未安装）、当时的默认 HOME 和三项系统动画缩放设置。它还会记录当时拥有 HOME 的包，但不会保存完整应用列表或全部系统设置。记录位于电脑的 `~/.cleanyourtv/`，按电视和列表分别保存。重复运行同一列表不会覆盖最初记录；新增列表项会补充记录。 将以下路径替换为**实际使用过的列表**后恢复： ```bash TV_HOST=192.168.1.50 tools/restore.sh examples/xiaomi-mi-tv-4a/debloat.txt ``` 如需指定原始桌面的备用包名，可增加最后一个参数。Google TV 常用的是 `com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx`，但应以实际设备为准： ```bash TV_HOST=192.168.1.50 tools/restore.sh "examples/你的机型/debloat.txt" com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx ``` - 有记录时，优先恢复当时实际拥有 HOME 的组件；当时没有解析到 HOME 或 HOME 已属于 CleanYourTV 时，使用指定的备用包名，未指定则默认尝试 `com.google.android.tvlauncher`。 - 记录中操作前已经停用的包会保持停用。恢复脚本还会尝试启用备用桌面包；如果它不在记录中，脚本无法判断其操作前状态。请先核对备用包名。 - 缺少记录时，脚本会提示并回退为启用列表内应用、将动画缩放恢复为 `1.0`；这不等同于精确恢复操作前状态。 - 恢复脚本不会卸载 CleanYourTV，也无法恢复列表之外的手动修改。若要卸载，可在电视「设置 → 应用」中操作。 - 无法连接 ADB 时，也可以尝试从电视系统设置中重新启用相关应用。 ## 故障排查 完整说明见 [`docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md`](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)。 - **macOS 提示 `No route to host`**：检查本地网络隐私权限；可尝试通过 `tools/venv/bin/python -I tools/tv.py` 使用仓库的 Python ADB 工具。 - **替换后 HOME 异常**：应先确认新桌面已安装且能够运行，再停用原始桌面。Shell 安装脚本按这个顺序执行；Windows 脚本的现有顺序见上文。 - **Google TV 设置向导抢占 HOME**：`com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith` 可能在原始桌面停用后抢占 HOME。先按故障排查文档检查它是否拥有当前 Wi-Fi 配置；直接停用可能删除该网络。清理工具会在这种情况下跳过它，需先在系统设置中忘记该 Wi-Fi，再重新加入。若已经异常，可尝试重新启用 Google TV 原始桌面：`tools/venv/bin/python -I tools/tv.py 'pm enable --user 0 com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx'`。 ## 常见问题 **会刷机或删除系统应用吗？** 不会。清理通过停用应用实现，但停用系统依赖仍可能造成故障，因此需要按机型核对、分批处理，并保留恢复路径。 **系统更新和应用更新会受影响吗？** 部分停用列表包含系统更新服务，需要重新启用后才能接收固件更新。常用流媒体应用仍可通过保留的应用商店更新；具体取决于设备和所用列表。 **能远程帮助其他人操作吗？** 可以通过私有 Tailscale 网络连接，详见[远程操作说明](docs/REMOTE.md)。不要在路由器上将 ADB 端口暴露到互联网。 **完成后要关闭调试吗？** 需要。本工具使用的传统 TCP ADB（默认 5555 端口）为明文连接，部分固件甚至不强制授权。完成后关闭 USB 调试及网络 / ADB 调试，撤销调试授权，并按[英文 README 的检查步骤](README.md#questions-people-ask)确认端口已关闭。 **支持私有 DNS 或 AirPlay 吗？** 私有 DNS 是部分 Android 版本提供的系统功能，并非桌面的广告过滤能力，也无法屏蔽所有视频广告。AirPlay 不属于桌面内置功能，需要另行安装和配置。相关可选方案见[英文常见问题](README.md#questions-people-ask)。 **有现成 APK 吗？** 目前仓库的使用方式是通过安装脚本编译并安装，方便根据设备调整配置。 ## 参与贡献 欢迎提交经过实际设备验证的机型清单、桌面改进、文档修正和主题。提交前请阅读
